id: \rThere are so many rare sales here. It's hard to find them anywhere else.
en: \rThere are so many rare sales here. It's hard to find them anywhere else.
it: \rQui ci sono tantissime offerte rare. È difficile trovarle da qualsiasi altra parte.

id: \bI'm almost in the Ultra Class. I won't be stopped.
en: \bI'm almost in the Ultra Class. I won't be stopped.
it: \bSono quasi nella Classe Ultra. Nessuno mi fermerà.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 273.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 273.
it: Rotom Phone: In base ai risultati, ora sei al posto 273 della classifica.

id: Incoming call from Professor Cerise:
en: Incoming call from Professor Cerise:
it: Chiamata in arrivo dalla Professoressa Cerise:

id: \bCerise: \PN, I have some exciting news for you. Wikstrom of the Kalos Elite Four is running a training facility. I suggest you check it out.
en: \bCerise: \PN, I have some exciting news for you.  Wikstrom of the Kalos Elite Four is running a training facility. I suggest you check it out.
it: \bCerise: \PN, ho una notizia entusiasmante per te.  Narciso dei Superquattro di Kalos gestisce un centro di allenamento. Ti consiglio di andarci.

id: \bIt's not an easy place to find, but I got you a free ride. Go to the blimp service in Lumiose City to head there.
en: \bIt's not an easy place to find, but I got you a free ride. Go to the blimp service in Lumiose City to head there.
it: \bNon è un posto facile da trovare, ma ti ho procurato un passaggio gratis. Vai al servizio dirigibili di Luminopoli per arrivarci.

id: \bI'll come back. We'll meet again once I get back into the Great Class.
en: \bI'll come back. We'll meet again once I get back into the Great Class.
it: \bTornerò. Ci rivedremo quando sarò di nuovo nella Classe Super.

id: \rWelcome to Stow-on-Side. Don't forget to check out the market!
en: \rWelcome to Stow-on-Side. Don't forget to check out the market!
it: \rBenvenuto a Stow-on-Side. Non dimenticare di fare un giro al mercato!

id: \bThere's a Hatterene hypnotizing people that get to close too the forest. It would be best to steer clear.
en: \bThere's a Hatterene hypnotizing people that get to close too the forest. It would be best to steer clear.
it: \bC'è un Hatterene che ipnotizza chi si avvicina troppo alla foresta. Meglio starne alla larga.

id: \bI work in the fields. It's better than trying to convince people to buy things they don't need. Food is forever after all.
en: \bI work in the fields. It's better than trying to convince people to buy things they don't need. Food is forever after all.
it: \bLavoro nei campi. Meglio che cercare di convincere la gente a comprare cose che non le servono. Il cibo è per sempre, dopotutto.

id: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Dawn:
en: Rotom Phone: Incoming call from Dawn:
it: Rotom Phone: chiamata in arrivo da Lucinda:

id: \rDawn: Hey \PN! I wanted to invite you to the Sinnoh Festival. It's a celebration of Sinnoh's past. Come to Canalave City if you're interested.
en: \rDawn: Hey \PN! I wanted to invite you to the Sinnoh Festival. It's a celebration of Sinnoh's past. Come to Canalave City if you're interested.
it: \rLucinda: Ciao \PN! Volevo invitarti al Festival di Sinnoh. È una celebrazione del passato di Sinnoh. Vieni a Canalipoli se ti interessa.

id: The door is locked.
en: The door is locked.
it: La porta è chiusa a chiave.

en: Stow-on-Side\nA vibrant town that has grown up around an ancient mural tucked away in the mountains.

id: \bI like to come down here to think.
en: \bI like to come down here to think.
it: \bMi piace venire quaggiù a riflettere.

id: \bYou seem to be of a similar mind. Take this.
en: \bYou seem to be of a similar mind. Take this.
it: \bSembri avere una mente simile alla mia. Prendi questo.

id: \bI found it one day while exploring. I don't know how it works. Makes you think though.
en: \bI found it one day while exploring. I don't know how it works. Makes you think though.
it: \bL'ho trovato un giorno mentre esploravo. Non so come funzioni. Però fa riflettere.
